scope: capability evidence role separation v0.3 -> v0.4
finding: The v0.3 semantic skeleton stripped Unicode punctuation, symbols, and whitespace but did not strip Unicode format controls (General_Category=Cf). A substantive evidence token could therefore be visually fragmented with zero-width or bidi-format controls and evade the bounded cross-role collision check.
adversarialExamples: ZERO WIDTH SPACE U+200B inserted inside a provenance token reused as authorization evidence
ZERO WIDTH JOINER U+200D inserted inside a reused token
bidirectional isolate/control characters inserted inside a reused token
risk: A single substantive evidence token could be presented as if it independently satisfied provenance, permission, or interface roles, creating false evidentiary separation and fake certainty.
constraints: Do not reinterpret this resolution as capability admission, authorization, execution, installation, or factual truth.
Do not broaden normalization to erase general combining marks or language-significant characters.
Preserve original observed atoms for audit; hardening affects collision comparison only.

resolution.mechanism: The bounded semantic collision skeleton now removes Unicode format controls (Cf) in addition to punctuation, symbols, and whitespace while retaining the original observed atoms. Format-control collisions receive a distinct diagnostic reason.
resolution.promotionBoundary: Focused CI success resolves this failure specimen. Public organism/registry state remains unchanged until broader evidence is complete; no body-admission authority is created by this guard.
